newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Andes in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes in private placement.

text.p: Pacific Andes International Holdings Ltd (PAIH) said on Monday a private placement of 82 million shares at HK$1.20 per share had been arranged.
The price represents a discount of some 5.51 percent to the stock's closing price of HK$1.27 on March 14, and the placement represents 17 percent of the company's issued share capital.
The shares were sold by N.S. Hong Invesment Ltd (NSH), which controls some 58.96 percent of the issued share capital.
Pacific Andes has also conditionally agreed to issue 82 million new shares to NSH, which would represent some 14.53 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of PAIH.
Trading in the seafood supplier stock was suspended at the company's request on Monday.
